newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ryanair says pretax profit to Mar 97 up 24.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ryanair says pretax profit to Mar 97 up 24.3 pct.

text.p: Irish airline Ryanair said on Tuesday that its pre-tax profit to March 1997 rose 24.3 percent to 25.6 million Irish pounds.
Ryanair unveiled its operating results for a three year period to end-March 1997 after it announced that it intends to seek a listing on the Irish stock exchange and the U.S. Nasdaq.
The 'low-cost' airline said operating revenues increased by 27.7 percent to 110.1 million in the fiscal year 1996 and by 23.9 percent to 136.4 million in the fiscal year 1997.
It said profit before tax rose by 31.2 percent to 20.6 milion in 1996 and by 24.3 million to 25.6 million in 1997.
Ryanair said operating profit rose by 34.3 percent to 19.2 million in 1996 and by 23.4 percent to 23.7 million in 1997.
It said prior to the combined offering, Ryanair was owned 61.7 percent by the Ryan family, 19.9 percent by Irish Air and 17.9 percent by Michael O'Leary, the Chief Executive of Ryanair.

Ryanair said after giving effect to the combined offering but without giving effect to the underwriters' over allotment option, the Ryan family, Irish Air and Michael O'Leary will own 35.3 percent, 15.7 percent and 14.1 percent of the outstanding shares, respectively.
